tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search Brain memory for relevant facts and episodes by semantic similarity.

namespace.description: Filter results to this namespace (e.g. 'personal', 'work'). Omit to search all.

tools.name: memory_store
tools.description: Store a structured semantic fact in Brain memory.

subject.description: The entity this fact is about (e.g. 'user', 'project-x')

object.description: The value of the relationship (e.g. 'Rust', 'Brain OS')

category.description: Category for the fact (e.g. 'personal', 'work'). Defaults to 'general'.

tools.name: memory_facts
tools.description: Retrieve all stored facts about a specific subject.

subject.description: The subject to retrieve facts about

tools.name: memory_episodes
tools.description: Retrieve recent conversation episodes from episodic memory.

tools.name: user_profile
tools.description: Retrieve the user profile and Brain OS configuration.

tools.name: memory_procedures
tools.description: Manage stored procedures (learned workflows). Use action='list' to see all, 'store' to save a new one, 'delete' to remove by id.

trigger.description: Keyword/phrase that activates the procedure (required for 'store')

steps.description: Ordered list of action steps (required for 'store')

tools.name: brain_capabilities
tools.description: List Brain's live capability manifest: every tool the kernel can dispatch to (native backends, terminal, mounted MCP servers) grouped by source and tagged with its safety tier, plus registered delegate agents. Read-only.
